No wine is completely hangover-proof because alcohol itself causes dehydration and acetaldehyde buildup . However, **dry, lower-alcohol wines (under 12.5%–13.5% ABV) with minimal added sugar and fewer additives** tend to be easier on your body than sweet, high-ABV, or heavily manipulated wines.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXX0_tPzv2REN_1hF5GPda07etE43atBg4YTX6mpupi0zn_mFhvC0nXWJPvU0BTTUgzQFB2GNKf9sH-v22qp8c-KaOOGfnyMk8L_sMTLHmTTL9AYrbYGdjngWsyHVlFb7S9q86hdOoILDhCgK2AeGDSYGAoNZ-V1-IvSw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXX75unlsQ8lgq1Vi0gIdAXgOdmoqYaxej0T6V4O_8Rw3Z7lTH3-G09SHui9tc5GKLawmgfIHNmr_pL20XyKlv85CI1VkMmkYt2tLowhuLysbVdzwkddJ9wMSi3-BunTzUz)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF16Vmnfxm5aTzOry1iG6ls6gVD2Daman3dFFEsK7R5Fgt_rBg9PQT5P3HsHlGFFy4MRbfRImdTow4RC3QJhkMwhwiGbDDXazNZ2dwqb3gvob7VpjXlnl9tpNcY-ZTv_oMQg96UKV7KTLYZdNQaF0SX_70WNQ2oCc242cD8M-i4vK3)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESggEBxCJF1zMXEP4ClWy-jQJKQOYBiSmpp6I_qUyLFvmRTScPps6XfwRAt7rOgf0hgVHJjecv9PAcPblq1-TlXfOTtx_RAic05daSAzqKJfK3SUpbrOtc5rkrL22bwWQYCSba4vamV0EWqEUA7fFPewWBqEL5KmsewN1DtCGp5U9xPTlJ)

For details on styles and pairings, see [Wine Folly](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXX0_tPzv2REN_1hF5GPda07etE43atBg4YTX6mpupi0zn_mFhvC0nXWJPvU0BTTUgzQFB2GNKf9sH-v22qp8c-KaOOGfnyMk8L_sMTLHmTTL9AYrbYGdjngWsyHVlFb7S9q86hdOoILDhCgK2AeGDSYGAoNZ-V1-IvSw).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF16Vmnfxm5aTzOry1iG6ls6gVD2Daman3dFFEsK7R5Fgt_rBg9PQT5P3HsHlGFFy4MRbfRImdTow4RC3QJhkMwhwiGbDDXazNZ2dwqb3gvob7VpjXlnl9tpNcY-ZTv_oMQg96UKV7KTLYZdNQaF0SX_70WNQ2oCc242cD8M-i4vK3)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESggEBxCJF1zMXEP4ClWy-jQJKQOYBiSmpp6I_qUyLFvmRTScPps6XfwRAt7rOgf0hgVHJjecv9PAcPblq1-TlXfOTtx_RAic05daSAzqKJfK3SUpbrOtc5rkrL22bwWQYCSba4vamV0EWqEUA7fFPewWBqEL5KmsewN1DtCGp5U9xPTlJ)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESowEBxCJF1xKJ6aKvkLE2VGTx4q0iHz3i23HVPzJ311mOH2wlKTyQXEJuXDJ1Ubd11Yv2PV5QlRBCKY1_QQUQIsN1nqci7XP2CcUIJu7Qv3ThQcOldToFixSh4PRt8GEpN8OCuJD8i7lIBQzp6RUGswEmJXh_BeMQiHtrFt-KWJ61B2g_ZWIDQaC7fmOwHHZRX-uQlBwEKOsm8oji2ErOcmLFODa8)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXXTs0hq2R7kc9RI156p_IF119QuTNEhNzgUj0ZnwiWWypipM4WcCH-UH3hsM0ZI0QHr5OFKfgytn3h-LY1LxwThDpUqw9SPmkpa7ACuP2g7z7fz-2jAs91NKvuBCwePxetdw)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXX0_tPzv2REN_1hF5GPda07etE43atBg4YTX6mpupi0zn_mFhvC0nXWJPvU0BTTUgzQFB2GNKf9sH-v22qp8c-KaOOGfnyMk8L_sMTLHmTTL9AYrbYGdjngWsyHVlFb7S9q86hdOoILDhCgK2AeGDSYGAoNZ-V1-IvSw)

### What Community Discussions Say

- There is a consensus on [Reddit](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESggEBxCJF1zMXEP4ClWy-jQJKQOYBiSmpp6I_qUyLFvmRTScPps6XfwRAt7rOgf0hgVHJjecv9PAcPblq1-TlXfOTtx_RAic05daSAzqKJfK3SUpbrOtc5rkrL22bwWQYCSba4vamV0EWqEUA7fFPewWBqEL5KmsewN1DtCGp5U9xPTlJ) that lower-ABV wines, very low residual sugar (under 5g/L), and fewer artificial winemaking shortcuts (like oak chips or powder) generally lead to milder hangovers.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESggEBxCJF1zMXEP4ClWy-jQJKQOYBiSmpp6I_qUyLFvmRTScPps6XfwRAt7rOgf0hgVHJjecv9PAcPblq1-TlXfOTtx_RAic05daSAzqKJfK3SUpbrOtc5rkrL22bwWQYCSba4vamV0EWqEUA7fFPewWBqEL5KmsewN1DtCGp5U9xPTlJ)
- There is also a consensus on [Quora](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESngEBxCJF18UqesnNpFGQD24mzo7WcgWnOyxUipHH9DfO0TCDilIylyJUse11_DtyyZ9mUXrnrNvbgGKQl_ESwOWKsiOwO0OO9ZkSzWZ3WcPrxKIFTWychCEkfPEN-Txl77tm2PCuXWAJILIj2oMxgNyrjpRwhaBXCE5Nti6bTjTPNydUy-4R6xUmWCRul1AynN7SvGaE3z4c3yN_Ohabew) that individual reactions vary—some drinkers find lighter-bodied or lower-tannin wines like Pinot Noir easier to tolerate than beer or heavier drinks.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESngEBxCJF18UqesnNpFGQD24mzo7WcgWnOyxUipHH9DfO0TCDilIylyJUse11_DtyyZ9mUXrnrNvbgGKQl_ESwOWKsiOwO0OO9ZkSzWZ3WcPrxKIFTWychCEkfPEN-Txl77tm2PCuXWAJILIj2oMxgNyrjpRwhaBXCE5Nti6bTjTPNydUy-4R6xUmWCRul1AynN7SvGaE3z4c3yN_Ohabew)

### Quick Ways to Cut Hangover Risk

- **Pace and hydrate:** Drink a glass of water for every glass of wine and eat food beforehand.
- **Skip sweet and syrupy wines:** Dessert wines, sweet whites, and heavily sweetened bottles pack extra sugar alongside alcohol.
- **Watch total volume:** Drinking less overall is the single most reliable way to wake up feeling good.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXX0_tPzv2REN_1hF5GPda07etE43atBg4YTX6mpupi0zn_mFhvC0nXWJPvU0BTTUgzQFB2GNKf9sH-v22qp8c-KaOOGfnyMk8L_sMTLHmTTL9AYrbYGdjngWsyHVlFb7S9q86hdOoILDhCgK2AeGDSYGAoNZ-V1-IvSw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF16Vmnfxm5aTzOry1iG6ls6gVD2Daman3dFFEsK7R5Fgt_rBg9PQT5P3HsHlGFFy4MRbfRImdTow4RC3QJhkMwhwiGbDDXazNZ2dwqb3gvob7VpjXlnl9tpNcY-ZTv_oMQg96UKV7KTLYZdNQaF0SX_70WNQ2oCc242cD8M-i4vK3)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXhQi8axkFgO25iQhsBvrAvdlQN2rvDCMVND7BI9aTKxJmmiEs5yOgwgM98iUiAndbG_hBs2q_IwfvHlKMpoJFSSr8CatFrpVfustL6JBA3zTsrZ1jwH2xMfRx1_99i45OcgKZbORx)

If you want to narrow down a bottle, share:

- Your **color preference** (red, white, rosé, or sparkling) and **taste** (dry, crisp, fruity, earthy)
- Your **budget** and whether you're shopping at a **grocery store or specialty wine shop** 
- **What you're pairing it with** (food, occasion, or relaxing at home)

- **Watch total volume:** Drinking less overall is the single most reliable way to wake up feeling good.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXX0_tPzv2REN_1hF5GPda07etE43atBg4YTX6mpupi0zn_mFhvC0nXWJPvU0BTTUgzQFB2GNKf9sH-v22qp8c-KaOOGfnyMk8L_sMTLHmTTL9AYrbYGdjngWsyHVlFb7S9q86hdOoILDhCgK2AeGDSYGAoNZ-V1-IvSw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF16Vmnfxm5aTzOry1iG6ls6gVD2Daman3dFFEsK7R5Fgt_rBg9PQT5P3HsHlGFFy4MRbfRImdTow4RC3QJhkMwhwiGbDDXazNZ2dwqb3gvob7VpjXlnl9tpNcY-ZTv_oMQg96UKV7KTLYZdNQaF0SX_70WNQ2oCc242cD8M-i4vK3)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXhQi8axkFgO25iQhsBvrAvdlQN2rvDCMVND7BI9aTKxJmmiEs5yOgwgM98iUiAndbG_hBs2q_IwfvHlKMpoJFSSr8CatFrpVfustL6JBA3zTsrZ1jwH2xMfRx1_99i45OcgKZbORx)
